checkpoint.note: Loaded read-only via HazardDetector(checkpoint_path=...). The detector's model_version string is a module constant ('saferoute-yolo11-v1') and is not updated when an alternate checkpoint is supplied; the checkpoint path/SHA above is authoritative.

split.name: val
split.provenance_note: Tag = which ORIGINAL split(s) contained the image. v1/v2 were trained on data/dataset.yaml (original split), so 'train' tagged images were seen during training. This is a leakage disclosure, not a scoring input.

class_specific_exploratory.note: The app exposes a single inference.conf (shared with the aggregator). Per-class thresholds would require a detector code change, so this is an exploratory upper bound, not a drop-in configuration.
